summary: Independently verified the Handover Pack + per-line warranty-tier feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (warranty-tiers endpoint, quote line tier preservation through fulfilment, PO -> GRN warranty stamping for extended_3yr/standard, pack 200 %PDF, 400 with no equipment, 404 unknown quote, auth guards). Extracted PDF text and confirmed per-unit warranty rows, cover-until dates (3yr/5yr), warranty summary wording, and BOTH 'how to log a fault' branches (Pulse portal URL when crm2_companies.tenant_org_id is set, phone/email service-desk fallback otherwise). Frontend: found and fixed a CRITICAL Rules-of-Hooks crash in QuoteHandoverPanel that blew up the whole quote-detail page ('Rendered more hooks than during the previous render'); after the fix the Warranty dropdown (populated from the tiers endpoint, hidden for non-sale line types), the handover-pack-row and the Download pack (PDF) button all work and the PDF downloads (QT-xxxx-pack.pdf, %PDF, 3.2KB). Pack row correctly absent for a quote with no GRN equipment.

minor.issue: company_name supplied without company_id is dropped (stored as ''), so the handover pack prints 'Customer —'. Pre-existing CPQ behaviour, not introduced by this feature, but it makes the branded pack look unfinished for quotes created without a linked company.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: useState('downloading') was declared AFTER the early `if (!data) return null;` return -> React threw 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' and the entire CRM quote detail page crashed to the red runtime-error overlay every time the handover panel loaded. Moved the hook above the early return. Please review/keep this fix.
React console error: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' from the line-type/warranty select area (hydration warning). Cosmetic but noisy.

issues: 'Complete deal' button uses very pale green background with near-white text when not ready — low contrast / reads as disabled-but-clickable ambiguity.

action_items: Keep/verify the hook-order fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/CRM/CRMQuoteHandover.js (downloading state must stay above `if (!data) return null;`). Add a lint/CI guard for hooks-after-early-return in CRM panels.
Optional: persist company_name on POST /crm/v2/quotes even without company_id so the pack header isn't blank.
Optional: fix the <span> inside <option> React warning in the CPQ line builder.
critical_code_review_comments: CRMQuoteHandover.js violated the Rules of Hooks (state declared after a conditional return) — this class of bug silently crashes the page only after data loads, so babel/compile success is not sufficient validation; always click through the panel.

utils/warranty.py compute_expiry uses 30.44-day months (approx) — 36 months resolves to 2029-08-26 which is fine, but a calendar-accurate month add would avoid off-by-a-day expiry disputes on warranty claims.
GET /handover/pack backfills warranty on read for legacy equipment but does not persist it — the pack and the equipment record can disagree later; consider a one-off migration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after tester fix (0% before — quote detail page crashed)

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the quote-detail crash: in CRMQuoteHandover.js the new download-pack feature added `const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false)` at line ~51, below the `if (!data) return null;` guard at line 27. First render (data === null) executed fewer hooks than the second render (data loaded), so React aborted with 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' and the CRM quote detail unmounted into the runtime-error overlay. Repro: open any CPQ v2 quote. Fix applied: hook moved up with the other useState declarations; re-tested, panel renders, pack row shows only when equipment_created>0, and the PDF downloads.
